scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice or offer to practice professional engineering or land surveying unless the person is an individual registered to practice under or exempt from the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of engineering or land surveying.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any offense determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon an individual's ability to serve the public as a professional engineer and land surveyor, or insufficient rehabilitation following conviction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any offense determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon an individual's ability to serve the public as a professional engineer and land surveyor; or when the board determines, following conviction of any offense, that an individual is not sufficiently rehabilitated under section 12.1-33-02.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the code of ethics adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of the code of ethics adopted by the board.

definition_quote.value: any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, engineering teaching of advanced engineering subjects or courses related thereto, engineering surveys, and the inspection of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with drawings and specifications
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of engineering and practice of professional engineering" means any service or creative work, the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, engineering teaching of advanced engineering subjects or courses related thereto, engineering surveys, and the inspection of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with drawings and specifications

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineer intern" means an individual who complies with the requirements for education, experience, and character and who has passed an examination in the fundamental engineering subjects, as provided in sections 43-19.1-12 and 43-19.1-15.

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: "Land surveyor intern" means an individual who complies with the requirements for education, experience, and character and who has passed an examination in the fundamentals of mathematics and the basic principles of land surveying as required in this chapter and as established by the board.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge" means direct control and personal supervision of engineering or surveying work.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Final engineering drawings, specifications, maps, plats, reports, or other documents prepared by a person required to be registered under this chapter, when presented to a client, contractor, subconsultant, or any public agency, must be signed, dated, and stamped with the seal or facsimile of the seal.

seal_document_types.quote: Final engineering drawings, specifications, maps, plats, reports, or other documents prepared by a person required to be registered under this chapter

firm_practice_allowed.quote: A registered professional engineer or registered land surveyor may practice or offer to practice professional engineering or land surveying as an organization or as an individual operating under a trade name if the organization is registered under or exempt from the provisions of this chapter.

value: Nonresident individual legally qualified by registration in another state or country (one-time temporary permit for definite period not to exceed one year for a specific job)
Employee or subordinate of a registered certificate holder whose work does not include final engineering or surveying designs or decisions and is done under direct supervision of a registrant
Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade
Individual regularly employed to perform engineering services solely for that individual's employer (in-house engineering exemption)
Performance of work ordinarily performed by a person that operates or maintains machinery or equipment
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter does not prevent or affect: 1. The practice or offer to practice engineering by an individual not a resident or having no established place of business in this state, if that individual is legally qualified by registration to practice engineering in another state or country that extends similar privileges to individuals registered under this chapter.

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The board shall cause to have prepared and shall adopt a code of ethics, a copy of which must be made available to every registrant and applicant for registration under this chapter

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: has had responsible charge of important engineering work for at least five years

retired_status_license_available.quote: "Retired registrant" means a duly registered professional engineer or land surveyor who is not engaged in active professional practice and is not required to meet the continuing professional education requirements as prescribed by the board. A retired registrant is issued a certificate of registration indicating "retired" status.
